about: Every asset in SCION-24's film, where it came from, its rights, and the operation that made it. Nothing was downloaded, filmed, traced or generated by a model.

assets.what: the dog: a parametric 2D rig (head keyform table 16 yaw x 5 pitch keys over named landmarks; torso volumes, neck, four legs, tail chain, collar and tag as art meshes on rotation deformers)
assets.operation: drawn in code (canvas paths); keyforms authored from a turnaround guide of head landmarks, rotated and projected once at load, then blended at run time

assets.what: coat pattern study (black-brown saddle and crown, tan legs and face, pale chest blaze, pricked ears) and general shepherd-mix proportions
assets.source: paeleo/handmade/kit/archive-dog/frames/f000.jpg, f012.jpg, f024.jpg, f036.jpg, f049.jpg (looked at only)
assets.operation: studied by eye; no pixel, mask, pose key or outline was copied or traced

assets.what: the dog's choices, position x and acting intentions per frame
assets.operation: drives the rig parameters; gait solved to planted feet; tail, ear and tag pendulums; expression director's tracks in build/motion.js

assets.what: the person: a small parametric portrait rig (head angle, blink, brow, mouth opening from the speech script, arms solved to targets, sit, lean, steps)
the house in section (wall, sill stone, door frame, door, room with lamp, picture, rug, bench), porch, railing, steps, yard, trees, dusk sky, moon, stars, door light
assets.operation: drawn in code; door light computed from the door's opening

assets.what: the person's lines: 'Come here.', 'Come here! Come on.', 'It's all right.', 'All right. Good dog.', 'Come in.'
assets.source: build/sound.py (formant synthesizer) and the speech script in build/motion.js
assets.operation: synthesized: glottal pulse train with breath noise through time-varying formant resonators, consonant bursts and noise; no recorded voice

assets.what: paws on boards (one per footfall the gait solver planted), collar tag jingles, lie-down flops, the dog's sigh, the person's steps, bench creak, latch and hinge creak
assets.source: build/sound.py with build/cache/events.json from the render

assets.what: dusk wind and crickets outside; a clock and a fire inside whose sound comes out as the door opens
Big Shoulders Display and Literata on the title and end cards
assets.rights: as provided in the repository (tools/paeleo/fonts); not re-verified here

not_used: archive-door frames (looked at nothing from it)
